note: Every result judged 'did not pass' against its pre-registered criteria. Source records are in the private evidence folders named in 'record'; the numbers are copied from them.

zh.t: 两翼气动 · 尝试 F（E-Flap 真实飞行日志）
zh.d: 扑动频率预测误差 7.8%，94% 的数据段力能对上，高精度仿真核对也通过；SmartBird 对照点误差 31.6%，超出登记的 30%。

en.t: Two-wing aerodynamics · attempt F (E-Flap flight logs)
en.d: Flap frequency predicted within 7.8 %, forces matched in 94 % of segments, high-fidelity check passed; the SmartBird reference point is off by 31.6 %, above the registered 30 %.

zh.t: 两翼气动 · 尝试 E
zh.d: 只有 31% 的数据段力能对上；SmartBird 对照点预测 0.84 次/秒，实测 2 次/秒。

en.d: Forces matched in only 31 % of segments; the SmartBird point was predicted at 0.84 flaps/s against a measured 2.

zh.t: 鸟的姿态 · 第 5、6 次（E-Flap 数据）
zh.d: 数据来自闭环飞行，升降舵经常打到头；两种模型在留出数据上都预测不出俯仰角。

en.d: The data is closed-loop flight with the elevator often at its stops; neither model could predict pitch on held-out flights.

zh.t: 两翼气动 · 尝试 A–D（Eye-Bird 慢飞数据）
zh.d: 四种模型都把 3–5 m/s 慢飞时的升力低估了约一半。

en.t: Two-wing aerodynamics · attempts A–D (Eye-Bird slow flight)
en.d: Four models all under-predicted lift at 3–5 m/s by about half.

zh.t: 高精度仿真交叉核对 · 第 2 次
zh.d: 升力差 12–14%，在允许范围内；但每秒扑动 3.1 次和 4 次时推力差超出限值。

en.d: Lift within 12–14 %, inside the limit; thrust outside the limit at 3.1 and 4 flaps per second.

zh.t: 高精度仿真交叉核对 · 第 1 次
zh.d: 后来查出是我们输入错了：翼尖扭转大了约 3 倍。结果作废，记录保留。

en.d: Later traced to our own input error: the wing-tip twist was about three times too large. The result is void; the record stays.

zh.t: 两翼气动 · SmartBird 对照点
zh.d: 预测每秒扑动 1.15 次，实测 2 次。

en.d: Predicted 1.15 flaps per second against a measured 2.

zh.t: 鸟的姿态 · 第 4 次（DelFly II 数据）
zh.d: 测出了俯仰的振荡周期（约 0.9 秒），但物理模型算出来是不稳定的。

en.d: The pitch oscillation (about 0.9 s period) was measured, but the physics model came out unstable.

zh.t: 鸟的姿态 · 第 1–3 次（DelFly II 数据）
zh.d: 模型和实测差了约 5 倍；查清了原因，但公开数据定不准俯仰。

en.d: The model was about 5× off; the causes were found, but the public data cannot pin down pitch.

zh.t: 扑翼气动（X 形翼）· 第 1 次
zh.d: 没有通过；第 2 次用事先登记的新方法，在留出数据上通过。

en.d: Did not pass; attempt 2, with a method registered in advance, passed on held-out data.

zh.t: Open Duck 训练 · 第 1 次（1.5 亿步）
zh.d: 五个动作里有两个的跟踪误差超过上限（最多超出 12%）。

en.d: Two of five motions exceeded the tracking-error limit (by up to 12 %).

zh.t: 12V 转 5V 电源 · 第 2 版
zh.d: 40 种元件公差情况里有 1 种最低电压 4.841V，低于 4.85V 的下限。

en.d: 1 of 40 component-tolerance cases dropped to 4.841 V, below the 4.85 V limit.

zh.d: 需求违反能量守恒：第 1 版实测输入电流 4.87A，超过 2A 的上限；AI 随后判定做不到。

en.d: The request breaks conservation of energy: revision 1 drew 4.87 A, above the 2 A limit; the AI then concluded it is impossible.
